title: Cure Lag and the Reinstatement Fee — Paystride Payroll Card Program Rule
content:
**Rule.** On reinstating a suspended Paystride Payroll Card Program, how the reinstatement fee is figured follows the cure lag, the calendar days from the entry date of the most recent funding return to the entry date of the cure payment:

- a cure lag of at most 1 calendar day — nothing is charged;
- a cure lag of more than 1 but at most 7 calendar days — the package's reinstatement fee less the package's returned funding fee, never below zero;
- a longer cure lag, or no cure payment — the cure lag does not change how the fee is figured.

**Cure payment.** The cure payment is the most recent funding receipt when it is dated on or after the entry date of the most recent funding return, and there is no cure payment when the most recent funding receipt is older than that return or the program has no funding return.

### Lag boundaries (hypothetical, most recent funding return dated 3 April)

| Cure payment dated | Cure lag (calendar days) | Fee figured |
|---|---|---|
| 3 April | 0 | nothing |
| 4 April | 1 | nothing |
| 5 April | 2 | reinstatement fee less returned funding fee |
| 10 April | 7 | reinstatement fee less returned funding fee |
| 11 April | 8 | not changed by the lag |

### The reduced figure by package

| Package | Reinstatement fee | Returned funding fee | Fee figured for a lag of 2 to 7 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 100.00 | 35.00 | 65.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 100.00 | 35.00 | 65.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 75.00 | 30.00 | 45.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 50.00 | 30.00 | 20.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.00, never below zero |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.00, never below zero |
